reviews.comment: Nothing crazy for the assignments, several in class activities (unannounced so go to class), and 3 papers, one being a group project with an in class presentation as the final. Great dude, he's passionate about the material which is easy to interact with. Usually announced what to read/watch to be able to engage in class dicussion the next day.

Professor Marlow is amazing, super chill, nice to talk to in any context. Lectures are better if you are engaging with the material and answer his questions, I wish I could take more with him. 3 coding assignments which weren't hard (resources available + an attempt to reubmit for a higher score), discussion posts/quizzes, one final, all online.
